text:
Staying one night in Hakone mostly for the ryokan? The Hakone Freepass costs ¥7,100 from Shinjuku, but a ryokan-first trip only needs about ¥3,662 in single fares. Here's when the pass actually pays you back 👇

We took our time with this one and checked every fare against Odakyu, Hakone Navi and a route search for a December weekday, because "just buy the pass" is the advice everyone repeats.

🛁 RYOKAN FIRST, ONE SHORT OUTING

1️⃣ Shinjuku to Gora and back is ¥1,671 each way on an IC card. Add a two-minute ride to the Open-Air Museum and back (¥160 each way) and you're at ¥3,662. That's about ¥3,400 less than the pass.

2️⃣ If your inn is in Hakone-Yumoto, where the Romancecar ends, it's ¥1,261 each way. No pass needed at all.

🚡 THE FULL LOOP

3️⃣ Add the cable car (¥430), ropeway (¥2,000), the boat across Lake Ashi (¥1,700) and the bus back down (¥1,210), and single fares reach ¥8,272. Now the pass wins by about ¥1,170.

🚄 COMING BY SHINKANSEN?

4️⃣ Buy the Odawara version (¥6,000). The Shinjuku pass includes an Odakyu round trip you won't use.

💬 OUR TAKE

If the bath and the dinner are the trip, tap your Suica and spend the difference on a better room. The moment the ropeway and the boat are both in your plan, buy the pass. The Romancecar fee (¥1,200) is extra either way.
